name: EH3D-LAB-BRIDGE
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: early code. A Rust library and command line that read a measured curve from one defined CSV format with units in the header, check a test record (instrument, conditions, quantity, SHA-256 of the data) and compare the measured curve with a simulated one, giving the deviation of every point with its expanded uncertainty and a verdict only against a tolerance that the person sets. It has only run on curves made by its own tests; the files of real instruments, instrument control and the link with the technical passport are not written, and no tolerance exists by default.
